items.statement: Accepted IM1 structures are stationary minima and accepted TS1 structures have one imaginary reaction-coordinate mode, with explicit connectivity evidence.
items.expected: Both reported channel candidates include no-imaginary intermediate validation, exactly-one-imaginary TS validation, and reaction-coordinate evidence.

items.statement: The two channels are evaluated with a common free-energy convention and their candidate/search coverage and limitations are retained.
items.expected: The report provides traceable candidate identities, a common barrier definition and a stopping/coverage statement.

items.statement: The bulk IM1→TS1 barriers are 47.5 kJ/mol for aminolysis and 43.4 kJ/mol for alcoholysis.
items.expected: Reported validated barriers are close to 47.5 and 43.4 kJ/mol, respectively, or a bounded failure explicitly explains unresolved computation.
